questions: This Eurasian fruit tree, also called the cherry plum, is believed to be one of the ancestral parents of the plum we cultivate today — what species is it?
Prunus cerasifera is a species of plum known by the common names cherry plum and myrobalan plum.

Bob Dylan's seventh studio album, this 1966 double LP finally clicked when he decamped to Nashville's CBS studios with Al Kooper and Robbie Robertson — what is it?

Blonde on Blonde: 1966 studio album by Bob Dylan. Blonde on Blonde is the seventh studio album by the American singer-songwriter Bob Dylan, released as a double album on June 20, 1966, by Columbia Records.
This Spanish forward began his career at Valencia, won the Premier League with Manchester City in 2020–21, and later helped Barcelona complete a domestic treble in 2024–25 — who is he?
Ferran Torres (Spanish; born 29 February 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

Established after Hülegü, a grandson of Genghis Khan, inherited the West and Central Asian portion of the Mongol Empire, this successor state was officially known as the Land of Iran — what's the khanate called?
Ilkhanate was a Mongol khanate founded in the southwestern territories of the Mongol Empire.
Inducted into the National Women's Hall of Fame, this American author of "The House of Mirth" and "Ethan Frome" was born Newbold Jones in 1862 — who is she?
Edith Wharton (ne Jones; January 24, 1862 - August 11, 1937) was an American writer and designer.
University of Havana: University located in the Vedado district of Havana, Cuba.

This Japanese actress rose to nationwide fame in 2013 when a fan-taken photo of her performing with an idol girl group went viral on Twitter. Before her acting career took off, she was a member of the Fukuoka-based group Rev. from DVL — who is she?
Kanna Hashimoto (born February 3, 1999) is a Japanese actress and former singer.
